newsitem.title: THAILAND: Electricity Gen unit in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Electricity Gen unit in joint venture.

text.p: Electricity Generating Plc said on Wednesday that its subsidiary had entered into a joint venture agreement with a Cayman Island-based firm to set up an electricity generating services company in Thailand.

Electricity Generating said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that its subsidiary Egco Engineering and Service Co Ltd signed the agreement on March 6 with CMS Generation Investment Co I to set up a company called CM Esco Energy Service Co Ltd.
Registered capital of the joint venture firm was one million baht ($38,462) and each party would hold a 50 percent stake in the total, it said.
EGCO shares were trading at 61.50 baht, up 1.50, at 0338 GMT on Wednesday.
